decisions.reason: The water phantom retains option value in the emerging particle therapy segment and no negative results have surfaced, so it is worth keeping despite its niche position.
The small volume ionization chamber addresses growing small-field dosimetry needs and remains a core product with ongoing demand.
This small volume chamber is partly redundant with Product B and other similar options, but it is still kept because no clear negative result justifies dropping it yet.
The standard clinical ionization chamber is a low-cost, established workhorse with stable demand.
The relative dosimetry chamber remains a standard tool in clinical workflows with limited carrying cost.
The thimble ionization chamber is a classic, widely used design that continues to justify its market presence.
